West Virginia: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open West Virginia on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 13, 2026. Applies to registration in person, by mail (postmarked) and online.
  • Early in-person voting: October 21, 2026 to October 31, 2026. Held at the county courthouse, an annex or a community voting location during business hours, including the last two Saturdays (9 a.m.–5 p.m.). No early voting on Sunday, Oct. 25.
  • Last day to apply for an absentee ballot: October 28, 2026. Your county clerk must receive the application by this date. Hand-delivered absentee ballots are due to the clerk by Nov. 2. Mailed ballots must be postmarked by Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. Bring a photo ID.

Official election information: West Virginia Secretary of State – GoVoteWV
